content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown sample with minimal analysis. We have many tools: we can get mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. Probably need to use mass spec to get molecular weight, then maybe NMR to deduce structure. But we have no initial data. We need to request data. The cheapest might be mass spec to get molecular formula. Then use isotope distribution? Actually mass spec can give m/z peaks. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool (no args). Let's call it correctly.
